subject: general
question:
Parts of sentences are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful paragraph. The first part 'R.' is fixed.

R. Mahatma Gandhi led a long struggle against untouchability

A. Dr B R Ambedkar, the father of the Indian Constitution, belonged to the lower

B. Such as entry into temples and public places

C. And worked for the welfare of the so called lower castes

D. Caste and made many efforts to secure basic rights for them
solution:
Here is the solution for the given question in the specified HTML format:

```html
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 
• The paragraph begins by introducing Mahatma Gandhi's struggle against untouchability and his work for the welfare of the lower castes. 
 
• **Sentence C is the second sentence** as it continues the idea of Gandhi's efforts: 
 
 
• "And worked for the welfare of the so-called lower castes"
